description: Final consolidation: re-derive the 1CQI interface and tetramer contacts, the enrichment sensitivity curves, and the exhaustive mirrortree over all six alpha-beta pairings
code:
import requests, numpy as np, json, itertools
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy import stats
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
     'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
     'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Re-derive the alpha-beta interface and the beta-beta (tetramer) surface
#    from PDB 1CQI (E. coli succinyl-CoA synthetase, ADP + Mg2+).
#    Chains A,D = alpha (SucD); B,E = beta (SucC).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
t=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1CQI.pdb",headers=H,timeout=90).text
ch=defaultdict(list)
for l in t.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[17:20].strip() in AA3 and l[16] in ' A':
        ch[l[21]].append((int(l[22:26]),l[17:20].strip(),
                          float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))

def contacts(v1,v2,cut=4.5):
    X=np.array([[a[2],a[3],a[4]] for a in v1]); Y=np.array([[a[2],a[3],a[4]] for a in v2])
    r1=np.array([a[0] for a in v1]);            r2=np.array([a[0] for a in v2])
    ii,jj=np.where(((X[:,None,:]-Y[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)<cut*cut)
    return set(zip(r1[ii].tolist(), r2[jj].tolist()))

cAB=contacts(ch['A'],ch['B']); cDE=contacts(ch['D'],ch['E'])
ifA_AB={a for a,b in cAB}; ifA_DE={a for a,b in cDE}
ifB_AB={b for a,b in cAB}; ifB_DE={b for a,b in cDE}
cBE=contacts(ch['B'],ch['E'])          # beta-beta, the tetramer interface
cAD=contacts(ch['A'],ch['D'])          # alpha-alpha
cAE=contacts(ch['A'],ch['E'])          # alpha to the NON-partner beta
print("PDB 1CQI contact census (heavy atoms < 4.5 A)")
print("  alpha-beta copy 1 (A-B): %3d alpha residues, %3d beta residues" % (len(ifA_AB),len(ifB_AB)))
print("  alpha-beta copy 2 (D-E): %3d alpha residues, %3d beta residues" % (len(ifA_DE),len(ifB_DE)))
print("  concordance between the two copies: alpha %d/%d, beta %d/%d"
      % (len(ifA_AB&ifA_DE),len(ifA_AB|ifA_DE),len(ifB_AB&ifB_DE),len(ifB_AB|ifB_DE)))
print("  beta-beta (B-E): %d + %d residues   <- holds the tetramer together"
      % (len({a for a,b in cBE}), len({b for a,b in cBE})))
print("  alpha-alpha (A-D): %d residues" % len({a for a,b in cAD}|{b for a,b in cAD}))
print("  alpha to non-partner beta (A-E): %d alpha residues" % len({a for a,b in cAE}))
print("  phosphohistidine His246 of E. coli SucD inside the computed alpha interface set:",
      246 in (ifA_AB|ifA_DE))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Enrichment test + full sensitivity curve
#    (counts carried from the alignments run in iterations 1-2)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
NA,IA,DA,KA = 309, 52, 14, 1     # alpha: positions, interface positions, differences, observed interfacial
NB,IB,DB,KB = 409, 42, 33, 0     # beta
def pgte(k,N,I,D): return stats.hypergeom.sf(k-1,N,I,D)
rows=[]
for lab,(N,I,D,K) in {"alpha":(NA,IA,DA,KA),"beta":(NB,IB,DB,KB)}.items():
    exp=D*I/N; p_obs=pgte(K,N,I,D)
    kmin=next(k for k in range(0,D+1) if pgte(k,N,I,D)<0.05)
    rows.append(dict(subunit=lab,n_positions=N,n_interface=I,n_diffs=D,obs_interface=K,
                     expected=round(exp,2),p_enriched=round(p_obs,4),
                     k_needed_for_p05=kmin,p_at_k_needed=round(pgte(kmin,N,I,D),4),
                     p_depleted=round(stats.hypergeom.cdf(K,N,I,D),4)))
enr=pd.DataFrame(rows); print("\nEnrichment of paralog differences at the alpha-beta interface"); print(enr.to_string(index=False))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Mirrortree / Mantel over the 3x3 pairing problem
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
Da=np.array([[0,0.0421,0.0227],[0.0421,0,0.0291],[0.0227,0.0291,0]])   # alpha p-distances
Db=np.array([[0,0.0611,0.0463],[0.0611,0,0.0709],[0.0463,0.0709,0]])   # beta  p-distances
iu=np.triu_indices(3,1); a=Da[iu]
perm_r={}
for p in itertools.permutations(range(3)):
    bb=Db[np.ix_(p,p)][iu]; perm_r[p]=np.corrcoef(a,bb)[0,1]
r_id=perm_r[(0,1,2)]
pmantel=np.mean([v>=r_id for v in perm_r.values()])
print("\nMirrortree / Mantel over all 3! = 6 pairings")
for p,v in sorted(perm_r.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1]):
    lbl=" ".join("a%d-b%d"%(i+1,p[i]+1) for i in range(3))
    print("   %-24s r = %+.3f%s" % (lbl, v, "   <- identity pairing" if p==(0,1,2) else ""))
print("   exhaustive permutation p = %.3f ; floor = 1/3! = %.3f, so p<0.05 is unreachable" % (pmantel,1/6))
print("   unrooted topologies on 3 leaves = 1, so the two gene trees are congruent by construction")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Figure
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,9))

# (a) sensitivity curves
for lab,(N,I,D,K),c in [("alpha",(NA,IA,DA,KA),"tab:blue"),("beta",(NB,IB,DB,KB),"tab:red")]:
    ks=np.arange(0,D+1); ps=[pgte(k,N,I,D) for k in ks]
    ax[0,0].semilogy(ks,ps,'-o',ms=3,color=c,label="%s (%d differences)"%(lab,D))
    ax[0,0].scatter([K],[pgte(K,N,I,D)],s=140,facecolors='none',edgecolors=c,linewidths=2,zorder=5)
ax[0,0].axhline(0.05,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax[0,0].text(20,0.058,"p = 0.05",fontsize=8)
ax[0,0].set_xlabel("interfacial differences observed, k"); ax[0,0].set_ylabel("one-sided hypergeometric p")
ax[0,0].set_title("a. The test could have detected a signal\n(circles mark the observed values)",fontsize=10)
ax[0,0].legend(fontsize=8)

# (b) family-wide conservation of the interface (values computed in iteration 2)
cons=pd.DataFrame({"subunit":["alpha","alpha","beta","beta"],
                   "set":["interface","rest","interface","rest"],
                   "identity":[0.752,0.672,0.725,0.499],
                   "n":[52,234,42,343]})
x=np.arange(4); cols=["#2b6cb0","#90cdf4","#9b2c2c","#feb2b2"]
ax[0,1].bar(x,cons.identity,color=cols)
for i,(v,n) in enumerate(zip(cons.identity,cons.n)):
    ax[0,1].text(i,v+0.012,"%.3f\n(n=%d)"%(v,n),ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax[0,1].set_xticks(x); ax[0,1].set_xticklabels(["alpha\ninterface","alpha\nrest","beta\ninterface","beta\nrest"],fontsize=8)
ax[0,1].set_ylim(0,0.92); ax[0,1].set_ylabel("mean per-column identity to E. coli")
ax[0,1].set_title("b. The interface is conserved family-wide\n(28 reviewed alphas, 28 reviewed betas)",fontsize=10)
ax[0,1].text(0.5,0.86,"p = 5.4e-03",ha='center',fontsize=8); ax[0,1].text(2.5,0.86,"p = 1.0e-05",ha='center',fontsize=8)

# (c) all six pairings scored
lbls=[" ".join("a%d-b%d"%(i+1,p[i]+1) for i in range(3)) for p in sorted(perm_r,key=lambda k:-perm_r[k])]
vals=[perm_r[p] for p in sorted(perm_r,key=lambda k:-perm_r[k])]
isid=[p==(0,1,2) for p in sorted(perm_r,key=lambda k:-perm_r[k])]
ax[1,0].barh(range(6),vals,color=["#dd6b20" if s else "#a0aec0" for s in isid])
ax[1,0].set_yticks(range(6)); ax[1,0].set_yticklabels(lbls,fontsize=8); ax[1,0].invert_yaxis()
ax[1,0].axvline(0,c='k',lw=0.8); ax[1,0].set_xlabel("Mantel r between alpha and beta distance matrices")
ax[1,0].set_title("c. Every pairing scores somewhere on the range\n(orange = identity pairing, exhaustive p = 0.50)",fontsize=10)

# (d) where the paralog differences actually fall
for i,(lab,(N,I,D,K)) in enumerate([("alpha",(NA,IA,DA,KA)),("beta",(NB,IB,DB,KB))]):
    ax[1,1].bar(i-0.18,K,0.34,color="#2f855a",label="at interface" if i==0 else None)
    ax[1,1].bar(i+0.18,D*I/N,0.34,color="#c6f6d5",label="expected at interface" if i==0 else None)
    ax[1,1].text(i-0.18,K+0.12,str(K),ha='center',fontsize=9)
    ax[1,1].text(i+0.18,D*I/N+0.12,"%.2f"%(D*I/N),ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax[1,1].set_xticks([0,1]); ax[1,1].set_xticklabels(["alpha\n14 differences / 309","beta\n33 differences / 409"],fontsize=9)
ax[1,1].set_ylabel("number of differences"); ax[1,1].set_ylim(0,4.2); ax[1,1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1,1].set_title("d. Observed interfacial differences fall below\nthe random expectation, not above it",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Provenance tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
enr.to_csv("enrichment_and_sensitivity.csv",index=False)
pd.DataFrame({"pairing":lbls,"mantel_r":vals,"is_identity_pairing":isid}).to_csv("mirrortree_all_pairings.csv",index=False)
cons.to_csv("family_wide_interface_conservation.csv",index=False)
print("\nwrote enrichment_and_sensitivity.csv, mirrortree_all_pairings.csv, family_wide_interface_conservation.csv")
